in_marathi.name: Balaash
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balaash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balaash is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bala', which means power or strength. In Hindu mythology, Bala is an epithet of Lord Vishnu, signifying his ability to protect and provide strength to his devotees.
